dog.title: Akamaru, the ninja dog
dog.text: Hear ye, hear ye: Akamaru will be part of the party, but don’t expect a particularly sociable dog! He will bark as soon as he sees you, perhaps ask for a few strokes, then promptly ignore you... he’s a professional charmer. One really important thing: please don’t feed him, even if he begs with those little eyes. Some of the food will be dangerous for dogs and we don’t want to take risks. Thanks for your help!
dog.name: Akamaru · 赤丸
